# ADR-033 — FCM V1 service-account key lives only in the EAS credential store, never in repo, `.env` or an agent path

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

The FCM V1 service-account private key is never stored in the repository, `.env`, or any agent-accessible path. It is uploaded directly by the user from their own terminal to the EAS credential store (`eas credentials` → Google Service Account → FCM V1) and deleted locally afterwards. No Android upload keystore is created, because local debug builds sign with Android's own debug keystore and EAS cloud builds are out of MVP scope
